decision_rule: Age/sex must be recoverable as structured numeric/binary fields, not only inside compound free text
fail_meaning: Covariates exist only in free text; pre-specified adjusted model not reproducible from deposit
warn_meaning: Covariates partly structured or provenance ambiguous
action_before_reuse: Restrict to structured fields and flag adjustment unavailable, or publish the parsing rule as code; never silently drop the covariate
applicability_boundary: PASS does not imply the covariate is confounder-free

required_deposited_fields: Group label plus ancestry/race field, or explicit statement that neither is deposited
decision_rule: Cross-tabulate group by ancestry; flag zero cells; compute phi, Pearson r, VIF, condition number, design rank
reported_metrics: group_x_ancestry_zero_cells; phi; pearson_r; vif; condition_number; design_rank
fail_meaning: Empty stratum makes the adjusted disease coefficient structurally non-identifiable despite full rank
warn_meaning: Imbalance without zero cell, or ancestry not deposited
action_before_reuse: Report zero cell and rank; restrict to balanced subset or flag ADJUSTMENT NOT POSSIBLE on every affected test; never interpret causally
applicability_boundary: Requires a deposited ancestry field; absence is WARN, not evidence of balance

decision_rule: Compare declared donor count with array count; detect technical replicates, paired eyes, shared donor IDs across platforms
fail_meaning: Arrays are not independent units but would be modelled as independent
warn_meaning: Duplicate/paired arrays plausible but not fully resolvable from deposited fields
action_before_reuse: Collapse technical replicates to donors before fitting; treat same-Series platforms as repeated measurements; report all plausible unit conventions separately when pairing is unverifiable
applicability_boundary: Correlation-based pairing is an unverifiable assumption and must be labelled as such

required_deposited_fields: Platform ID, official GPL*.annot.gz availability, probe-to-gene column
decision_rule: Verify official annotation availability; report mapping coverage for the matrix probe set
fail_meaning: No official annotation and no documented rebuild
warn_meaning: Coverage partial, or a local rebuild used instead of official file
action_before_reuse: Keep unmapped probes as missing annotation, never negative results; publish source, row count, extraction rule and non-official status; keep output in a separate boundary-check directory
applicability_boundary: Locally rebuilt map is not equivalent to official annotation and must not enter the primary result

required_deposited_fields: Expression distribution, !Sample_data_processing, all group labels including non-target arms
decision_rule: Infer linear vs log2-like scale from min/median/max; enumerate groups that must be excluded from the pre-specified contrast
fail_meaning: Scale incompatible with intended fold-change threshold, or ineligible group would enter contrast
warn_meaning: Scale inference ambiguous, or exclusions reduce residual df materially
action_before_reuse: Record scale decision in QC and apply one transform consistently; exclude ineligible arms before fitting; report resulting residual df
applicability_boundary: Descriptive inference; not a substitute for checking the original processing pipeline
